note: Based on recorded events; coverage is more limited before the year 2000. Longer historical trends may partly reflect reporting improvements.
title: Decadal average: Annual number of people requiring immediate assistance due to storms
subtitle: Decadal figures are measured as the annual average over the subsequent ten-year period. Storms include tornadoes, hailstorms, thunderstorms, sandstorms, blizzards, and extreme wind events.
